title: Development and validation of a prognostic COVID-19 severity assessment (COSA) score and machine learning models for patient triage at a tertiary hospital
summary: The full preprint reports a clinical score and learned models for severe COVID-19 outcomes, with prospective second-wave validation at the same hospital; scope is bounded to that cohort. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
ai_technology: Support-vector and other machine-learning prognostic models
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The frozen COSA score and learned models were prospectively evaluated on a second wave of 459 patients without recalibration at the same hospital; model development used the first wave (n=198).
evidence.unknown: The reviewed study does not establish validation or benefit beyond its reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: The paper trains support-vector and other ML models from early routine measurements to predict severe hospitalization outcomes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
